mechanism: Oxybutynin's anticholinergic effects may be potentiated by methylprednisolone's immunosuppressive and CNS effects, while methylprednisolone can increase infection risk in patients on anticholinergic therapy due to urinary retention.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic side effects and urinary retention; ensure adequate fluid intake and consider alternative agents if possible; assess infection risk given immunosuppression.
